pages.title: About QuickPostly
pages.metaDescription: Learn about QuickPostly mission to help creators and businesses master social publishing with category-based automation.

contentJson.bodyHtml:
Built to eliminate social media chaos for modern marketing teams

QuickPostly was engineered to transform how agencies, brands, and solo entrepreneurs publish, engage, and grow across global social networks.

The Problem with Ordinary Social Schedulers

Traditional social schedulers force you into a daily hamster wheel: write a post, pick a time slot, repeat tomorrow. The result? Inconsistent content varieties, burnt-out social teams, and valuable evergreen insights that disappear after 24 hours.

The Category-Based Solution

QuickPostly changes the paradigm with Category-Based Scheduling and Evergreen Content Automation. You establish intentional content buckets (e.g., Thought Leadership, Industry News, Product Highlights, Customer Stories) and link them to dedicated publishing slots.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.metaDescription: Learn how QuickPostly collects, protects, and handles your data and social media tokens.

contentJson.bodyHtml:
1. Introduction & Scope

QuickPostly Technologies Inc. ("QuickPostly", "we", "us", or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring transparency regarding how we handle your personal data. This Privacy Policy governs the collection, use, and disclosure of information obtained when you access or use our websites, APIs, and SaaS platform.

2. Information We Collect

  • Account Information: Name, email address, password hash, company name, and billing details.
  • Social Media Profile Data & Tokens: Secure OAuth access tokens for X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, and TikTok.
  • User Content & Media: Post copy, hashtags, images, and videos uploaded to your queues.
  • Telemetry & Usage Data: IP addresses, browser types, and diagnostics for platform reliability.

3. How We Use Your Data

We use your information exclusively to deliver category scheduling, authenticate users, execute AI drafting, and ensure API rate limit compliance.

4. Social Network API Compliance

QuickPostly adheres strictly to the Developer Terms and API policies of all connected social networks. We never sell your social tokens or follower analytics to data brokers.

5. Security & Data Retention

We employ AES-256 encryption for stored tokens and TLS 1.3 encryption in transit. OAuth tokens are immediately revoked upon account deletion.

6. Contact Privacy Team

Questions regarding our privacy practices? Contact us at support@quickpostly.com.

1. Agreement to Terms

By accessing or creating an account on QuickPostly ("Service"), operated by QuickPostly Technologies Inc., you agree to be bound by these Terms and Conditions.

2. User Accounts & Workspaces

You must provide accurate information during registration. You are responsible for safeguarding your login credentials and maintaining the confidentiality of your workspace API keys.

3. Acceptable Use Policy

You agree not to use QuickPostly to violate third-party API policies, publish malicious content or unsolicited spam, or abuse automated queue frequencies.

4. Subscriptions, Billing & Cancellations

QuickPostly provides subscription services billed in advance on a recurring monthly or annual basis. You may cancel your subscription at any time from your billing dashboard.

5. Intellectual Property & User Content

You retain 100% full ownership of all text, media, graphics, and video content you schedule through QuickPostly.

6. Limitation of Liability

To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, QuickPostly Technologies Inc. shall not be liable for indirect damages resulting from third-party social media API downtime.

faqs.question: How is QuickPostly different from ordinary social media schedulers?
faqs.answer: Unlike generic chronological schedulers that require you to pick a time for every single post, QuickPostly implements category-based content queuing. You organize posts by purpose (e.g. Evergreen, Curated, Promotional, Educational), and our scheduling engine automatically slots them into your optimized weekly timetable.

faqs.question: What social media channels does QuickPostly support?
faqs.answer: QuickPostly connects directly to X (Twitter), LinkedIn Personal Profiles & Company Pages, Facebook Pages & Groups, Instagram Business & Creator accounts, Pinterest, TikTok, YouTube Community & Shorts, Threads, and Google Business Profiles.

faqs.question: Can I manage multiple clients with custom approval flows?
faqs.answer: Yes! Our Agency tier gives you isolated workspaces for each client brand. You can invite client stakeholders with restricted "Viewer" or "Approver" roles, allowing them to review, comment on, and approve draft schedules before publication.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial and can I cancel anytime?
faqs.answer: We offer an unrestricted 14-day free trial on all plans without requiring upfront contracts or credit cards. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time directly through your workspace settings.

faqs.question: How does QuickPostly protect our social media credentials?
faqs.answer: QuickPostly never stores your actual account passwords. We utilize official OAuth 2.0 API integrations certified by Meta, LinkedIn, X, and Google, with bank-grade encryption at rest and in transit.

blogPosts.title: Why Category-Based Social Queuing Beats Chronological Scheduling
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover why top growth teams are abandoning manual calendar dates in favor of automated evergreen queues.
blogPosts.contentHtml:
Scheduling individual social posts one by one is one of the highest friction activities in modern marketing. When a post fails to publish or a campaign priority shifts, manual calendars fall apart.

The Core Principle of Content Queues

By categorizing your content into predictable pillars—such as Evergreen Insights, Industry Highlights, and Product Demos—you establish a resilient publishing rhythm that runs on autopilot without daily oversight.

Category scheduling decouples content ideation from publishing mechanics.

Once you implement automated buffer recycling, evergreen content keeps generating qualified inbound pipeline indefinitely.
blogPosts.metaDescription: Discover why top growth teams are abandoning manual calendar dates in favor of automated evergreen queues.

blogPosts.title: Mastering Multi-Network AI Repurposing: From Longform to Viral Threads
blogPosts.excerpt: A step-by-step breakdown of how to transform a single blog post into 10 platform-tailored updates.
blogPosts.contentHtml:
Every high-value blog post or customer case study contains at least a dozen distinct insights. Instead of sharing a bare link that gets algorithmically suppressed, top creators break it down into native visual carousels and concise threads.

Adapting Voice for Each Platform

  • LinkedIn: Focus on professional takeaways, operational lessons, and data proof-points.
  • X (Twitter): Craft compelling opening hooks and crisp numbered threads.
  • Instagram: Transform key takeaways into carousel slides with high readability.
blogPosts.metaDescription: Step-by-step framework to repurpose longform content into high-converting social updates.

blogPosts.title: Eliminating the Feedback Loop: Agency Approval Workflows That Scale
blogPosts.excerpt: How to manage multi-client content approvals without endless email threads and missed deadlines.
blogPosts.contentHtml:
When managing dozens of client brands, the single greatest bottleneck is client approvals. Traditional agencies drown in Google Docs, spreadsheet comment threads, and emergency Slack messages.

Isolated Brand Workspaces with Role-Based Approvals

By giving each client their own branded workspace with a designated Approver seat, clients can preview posts in their exact native format and give single-click approvals.
